reviewer_routing.reason: Session runs in an ephemeral remote container with no local stack: no `ollama` binary, no listener on 127.0.0.1:11434, OLLAMA_HOST unset, 15 GB RAM and no GPU. Both band-chain models are structurally unreachable (gemma4:26b ~16 GB and muse-glimmer:30b ~18 GB exceed available RAM), so this is infrastructure-level unavailability rather than a retryable stall.
reviewer_routing.provider_route_reason: Cross-provider D14 attempted first and unavailable: no Codex/OpenAI CLI or credentials in this environment, and every agent type exposed to the orchestrator resolves to the same provider (Anthropic). Same-provider D14 used as the recorded degraded final fallback with context isolation preserved (subagent received only the task definition, acceptance criteria, and file contents; no development transcript).

findings.detail: Declared scope is `crates/jobs/src/subtitle_job.rs` only, but lib.rs re-exports `SubtitlePostReadyRoute` (line 12) and calls the 3-argument `SubtitleJob::new(..)` at lines 277 and 356. Collapsing the constructor to (asset_id, project_id) breaks compilation of the task's own crate: `cargo check -p dubbridge-jobs` cannot pass within the declared scope.

Line 122 reads `job.target_language` in production post-ready logic. No task before T2c-vi-a is scoped to touch this file, so removing the field leaves the worker-runner binary non-compiling across T2c-iv-a, T2c-iv-b, T2c-iv-c and T2c-v. This conflicts with the repository rule that no commit may land with broken tests.

Line 508 asserts `jobs[0].target_language == "de"`, and this file is not assigned to any task in the current T2c decomposition, including T2c-vi-a. The sequence therefore has no planned owner for this breakage.

Five call sites use the 3-argument constructor (lines 166, 217, 284, 334, 357). Covered by T2c-vi-a's declared paths, but only after three intermediate tasks land, so the same non-compiling window as F2 applies.

questions_resolved.q1_scope_sufficient: No. `crates/jobs/src/lib.rs` requires edits for the task's own crate to compile; the ledger's `Files expected to change` line is factually incomplete.
questions_resolved.q2_workspace_breakage: Yes. `cargo build --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace` break if the task lands as scoped. Not an acceptable intermediate state under the current unqualified testing rule.
questions_resolved.q3_sequencing_sound: No. The worker-runner binary stays non-compiling across four sequenced tasks, and transcription_runtime.rs has no planned fix at all.

recommended_resolution: Expand T2c-iv-a `Files expected to change` to include `crates/jobs/src/lib.rs` (re-export list plus the two test call sites), or revise the acceptance criteria.

Decide explicitly between (a) bundling T2c-iv-a with T2c-iv-b and the runtime fixes into one workspace-green change, or (b) a documented compatibility shim that keeps the workspace compiling until T2c-vi-a.
Assign `apps/worker-runner/src/transcription_runtime.rs` to a concrete task in the decomposition.
